# Common WoW map IDs (client Load Map)

IDs appear in `Client.log` as `Load Map Begin : <id>`.

## Continents / hubs

| ID | Zone |
|----|------|
| 0 | Eastern Kingdoms |
| 1 | Kalimdor |
| 530 | Outland |
| 571 | Northrend |
| 646 | Deepholm (and related Cata zones vary) |
| 730 | Maelstrom / some Cata |
| 860 | The Wandering Isle |
| 870 | Pandaria |
| 1064 | Isle of Thunder (when applicable) |

## Capitals / notable (instance map IDs differ from world)

World cities often load as part of continent maps (0/1/530/870), not unique IDs.
Instance IDs are separate; if needed, look up on Wowhead by map/instance id for the expansion.

## MoP orientation

- **530** after login → character left in Outland (e.g. Shattrath)
- **870** → Pandaria (Vale / Shrine area when in open world)
- **0** → EK (Stormwind area is on Eastern Kingdoms)

## Tip

If only continent IDs appear, combine with user report (Shat, SW, Shrine) rather than over-claiming exact subzone.
